title: rosa lepidinula
intro:
Rosa lepidinula, commonly known as the fragrant rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Rosa lepidinula include its use in treating digestive issues, such as dyspepsia and gastritis, due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve anxiety, and act as a natural antiseptic. Rosa lepidinula contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
